description: Captures the rendered layout of a webpage as a spatial tree of elements, with positions, sizes, grid layouts, backgrounds, and overlay occlusion, via the web CLI. Returns indented text, a JSON tree, and a map from node IDs to CSS selectors. Use before page decomposition, overlay detection, or brand extraction, or when the user asks for a page's visual hierarchy or layout.
